scripts.generate: uv run python ../../scripts/export_openapi.py openapi.json && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/schema.d.ts --default-non-nullable false
scripts.check-fresh: uv run python ../../scripts/export_openapi.py openapi.check.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.readFileSync('openapi.json','utf8')!==fs.readFileSync('openapi.check.json','utf8')){console.error('openapi.json is stale: run pnpm api-client:generate');process.exit(1)}fs.unlinkSync('openapi.check.json')"
